Container.Name: lan-sheriff
Container.Overview:
Watches every connection leaving this machine, maps where it is headed on a world map, names the application responsible, and flags behaviour worth a second look. It observes only: nothing is ever blocked, dropped or modified.
Network type must stay on Host. On a bridge the container watches Docker's own network and the dashboard comes up empty.
Unraid sits on the LAN rather than between the LAN and the internet, so Patrol Mode will see this server's traffic and broadcast, and not the rest. Seeing other devices needs a mirror or SPAN port. The dashboard says so rather than looking broken.
